findings.finding: An ordinary pointerdown refreshes the old selection via renderAlignmentGuideControls→renderQuickToolbar, then refreshes the new selection via finishSelectionUI→renderSelectionProperties→renderQuickToolbar. Both routes synchronously read layer-host scrollTop after UI writes.
findings.minimumProposal: Only reset/redraw guide UI on ordinary pointerdown when a guide was actually selected. Keep the genuine guide-selection branch and the final canonical new-selection update.
